title: Barbering Techniques for Hairstylists: Client Consultation and Analysis
summary: PRD Appendix A: consider face shape, head shape and growth patterns; client preferences come first.

title: Pall Mall Barbers: Best men's hairstyles by face shape
summary: Grooming guidance cited by PRD Appendix A, advisory rather than a beauty ranking.

title: The Manual: Best haircut for your face
summary: Grooming guidance cited by PRD Appendix A. Sources disagree on oblong: side width/fullness and the lengthening effect of short sides require barber judgment.

title: Gentleman's Gazette: How to get the best haircut for your face shape
summary: Grooming guidance cited by PRD Appendix A. Record both oblong views about width at the sides and very short sides; let the barber decide.

title: Face shape classification using Inception v3
summary: PRD Appendix A accuracy caveat: small, subjectively labeled datasets and boundary detection failures limit generalization; this does not validate GupAi's heuristic.

title: MediaPipe Face Landmarker
summary: Local landmark model; no identity recognition or embeddings are used by GupAi.
